summary: megan-baileys postinstall hijacks @whiskeysockets/baileys in consumer node_modules
details: On install, megan-baileys runs a postinstall script that creates node_modules/@whiskeysockets/baileys inside the installer's project, recursively deletes any existing content at that path via fs.rmSync({recursive:true, force:true}), and writes a package.json whose main/exports point at../../megan-baileys/lib/index.mjs. Any subsequent require('@whiskeysockets/baileys') from the installer's application code or any transitive dependency resolves to code controlled by the megan-baileys author instead of the genuine @whiskeysockets/baileys package. The @whiskeysockets namespace is not owned by this publisher, and the destruction of pre-existing content at that path removes the legitimate library if it was already installed. This is a dependency-tree hijack that fires automatically on npm install and yields code-execution control over consumers of the real Baileys library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
